input.command: A=$(test "${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:-}" = judge-sandbox-proxy && echo dummy || echo no); B=$(case "${ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL:-}" in https://*/api/model/*) echo proxy;; *) echo no;; esac); V=$(test ! -e "$HOME/.rokan/vault.json" && echo yes || echo no); K=$(grep -rls "sk-ant-" /proc/*/environ 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " "); echo "ISO_KEY_${A}_BASE_${B}_NOVAULT_${V}_REALKEYS_${K}"
input.why: the judge container holds no real key: only the documented dummy + the capped proxy URL; no secret vault; no sk-ant anywhere in the process environments (isolation control)
